newsitem.title: USA: Travelers names ex TIAA-CREF vice chairman.
newsitem.headline: Travelers names ex TIAA-CREF vice chairman.

text.p: Travelers Group Inc said Thursday that it had named Thomas Jones as a vice chairman, effective August 18.
Jones was formerly president, chief operating officer and vice chairman of the Teachers Insurance and Annuity Association - College Retirement Equities Fund.
Jones has also served as chief financial officer of TIAA-CREF, the nation's largest pension system with about $200 billion in assets under management.
At Travelers he will be chairman and chief executive of a new unit that combines all Smith Barney's asset management operations into a single corporate division called Smith Barney Asset Management.

At mid-year the division had about $120 billion in assets under fee-based management, including $81.5 billion in money market and mutual funds and $42.8 billion in institutional and individual assets, Travelers said.
Jones will report to Travelers Group Inc Chairman and Chief Executive Sanford Weill.
